summary: Iteration 3 (imagery preview + change crops + multi-date timeseries persistence) validated. Backend: 3 passed + 2 skipped-by-design; observation preview PNG (95 KB) verified for cached Rome-Live S2 TIF; /observations/{id}/preview returns image/png with valid PNG magic; 404 on unknown id works; /change-detection/timeseries triggered on Rome-Live and completed with diagnostics.mode='real', total_pairs=4 (int), tracks=0 (int), pair_details list — contract holds; /changes/{id}/crop/{before,after,diff} return 200 image/png (validated against CRL events). Frontend: Rome-Live shows 24 set-before-*/set-after-* buttons, imagery-layer-toggle appears with layer-before/after/off buttons after selecting BEFORE+AFTER, clicking layer-after loads real Sentinel-2 RGB overlay (visible Rome city + clouds), layer-off removes it. run-timeseries-btn shows 'RUN TIME-SERIES (23 PAIRS)' — enabled with 24 obs, disabled when <2 (implicit — 23 pairs > 2). Clicking it fires POST /api/v1/change-detection/timeseries. Change-row-* click on CRL opens change detail; cf-before/cf-after/cf-diff tags exist, all 3 crop requests fire and return HTTP 200 image/png.

minor.issue: Rome-Live timeseries produced 0 tracks despite total_pairs=4. Reason: consecutive observations returned by the imagery-search pipeline are duplicate dates across adjacent Sentinel-2 tiles (e.g., pair 0 has before=S2A_...20240603T100031_T32TQM and after=S2A_...20240603T100031_T33TTG — same acquisition datetime, different tile). Change detection between them yields zero polygons. Recommend dedupe by observation_datetime OR pick a single tile stream per AOI when building the observation series.

Crop PNGs from CRL AOI events are tiny (11x10 px, 70-226 bytes). This is because the polygon bbox spans only a few source TIF pixels. Recommend upscaling to a minimum thumbnail size (e.g., 256x256 with BICUBIC) inside render_observation_png / render_difference_png so the UI thumbnails are legible.

issues: Backend returns very small PNGs (11x10) so on-screen thumbnails will look blurry/pixelated even though status=200. Server-side upscale recommended (see backend minor issue).

action_items: Fix duplicate-date observations in timeseries pipeline: dedupe by observation_datetime (or restrict to a single MGRS tile) before pairing, otherwise persistence never fires because zero polygons are detected across identical dates.
Upscale change crops to a minimum thumbnail size in render_observation_png/render_difference_png so cf-before/cf-after/cf-diff render clearly in the UI (currently 11x10 px).
critical_code_review_comments: orchestrator.run_timeseries_detection caps at MAX_PAIRS=4 but does not dedupe by date, so with tile-overlapping AOIs like Rome-Live the first 5 observations may all share ~2 unique dates. Suggest: dedupe by observation_datetime keeping the lowest cloud_percentage before pairing.
server._ensure_obs_tif silently swallows CDSE fetch errors into HTTPException(502); consider structured logging of the CDSE HTTP status to speed debugging when Process API rate-limits.

server.change_crop returns tiny PNGs when polygon bbox is small — no minimum-size enforcement. Add a target_size arg (e.g., 256) to render_observation_png/render_difference_png and resize with PIL BICUBIC.
polygon_bbox_padded only reads coordinates[0] — will KeyError/IndexError for MultiPolygon geometries. Handle geometry.type in ('Polygon','MultiPolygon').

previews.render_observation_png assumes SCL band exists at index 5 for S2 but never uses it; also assumes TIF is EPSG:4326 which is only true for Sentinel Hub Process API responses — document this in the docstring or reproject.

rca of the issue: Bug (timeseries persistence not exercised on Rome-Live): imagery search for Rome-Live returns Sentinel-2 products from two adjacent MGRS tiles (T32TQM covering ~11.4–12.7°E, 41.4–42.4°N and T33TTG covering the same AOI from the neighbouring UTM zone). Both tiles are acquired in the same overpass so their observation_datetime is identical. run_timeseries_detection sorts by observation_datetime and takes consecutive pairs — the first 4 pairs of Rome-Live are (T32TQM_20240603, T33TTG_20240603), (T33TTG_20240603, T32TQM_20240608), (T32TQM_20240608, T33TTG_20240608), (T33TTG_20240608, T32TQM_20240618). Same-day tile-neighbour pairs produce no change signal; tile-swap pairs across dates produce noise but no coherent tracks. Mitigation: in _run_timeseries_job (server.py:388) OR run_timeseries_detection (orchestrator.py:121) group observations by date and keep the lowest cloud_percentage per date; alternatively pin the AOI to a single tile at ingest time.
